title: Managed Integration Accelerator: checklist + UX & copy playbook (WIP)
summary: Working playbook for onboarding partners into managed/marketplace listings. Focused on eligibility checks, trial provisioning UX, SKU fallback rules, and short copy variants for listing and trial touchpoints.
body:
Purpose
- Create a compact, repeatable checklist and short-copy library so Sales / Solutions / Partner engineers can spin up a marketplace-enabled integration in 1–2 weeks (target).
- Emphasize the trial path: self-service activation -> usage telemetry -> conversion measurement.

Audience
- Primary: Partner PMs, partner engineering, partner ops.
- Secondary: Marketplace program managers, docs, legal (for quick questions).

High-level goals (metrics we care about)
- Time-to-live (TTL) for listing from kickoff: target <= 14 calendar days (pilot).
- Trial activation conversion: > 8% activated from invite link within 7 days.
- First-week API calls per trial: >= 200 tokens or 5 generation requests (signals healthy integration).
- SKU misrouted incidents: <= 2 per quarter.

Quick checklist (pre-listing technical & ops gates)
1) Eligibility & contract
   - Confirm partner tier (ISV / Managed / Marketplace-only).
   - Contract addendum drafted for revenue share / metering model (legal signoff).
   - KYC / security questionnaire completed if handling PII.
2) Technical integration
   - Auth model agreed (OAuth OIDC vs API key).
   - Sandbox credentials provided & validated (sample request flow passes).
   - Billing SKU(s) defined and validated with finance (see SKU mapping below).
   - Model variant(s) selected and documented (cost vs latency tiers).
3) Trial provisioning flow
   - One-click trial link or partner-portal activation endpoint ready.
   - Trial entitlements defined: tokens, model access, retention window.
   - Auto-fallback for exceeding quota -> transparent soft-limit messages in UI.
4) UX + copy readiness
   - Listing short description (<= 220 chars) drafted.
   - Step-by-step activation instructions created (console + API).
   - Deep link pattern for console logs and observability attached in integration.
5) Observability & SLOs
   - Metrics collection: activation rate, calls per trial, error-rate, latency buckets.
   - Alerting thresholds for partner support on onboarding flow.
6) Security & compliance
   - Data residency / encryption requirements captured.
   - KMS/HSM integration doc stub if customer requires key control.
7) Post-launch ops
   - Support runbook: escalation path, sample logs to share, common troubleshooting commands.
   - Billing reconciliation cadence with partner ops defined.

SKU & Metering guidance (ops cheat-sheet)
- Primary SKU: redwood.generated-unit (metering by tokens). Default packaging: 100k token increments for trials.
- Fallback SKU mapping: if partner lists a packaged product (e.g., 1K calls), create mapping table that converts calls->tokens by typical prompt sizes; store mapping in the marketplace metadata.
- Edge cases: streaming vs non-streaming billing. Ensure partner labeling on listing matches metering mode.

Trial provisioning UX: recommended flows + copy snippets
1) Invite email / partner console card (short)
   - Subject: Try [PartnerApp] on Redwood — 14‑day sandbox ready
   - Snippet: Activate a free trial of [PartnerApp] to evaluate LLM features with sample prompts and safe defaults. No credit card required.
2) Quick-start modal (in console)
   - Title: Start your free trial of [PartnerApp]
   - Body: You’ll get 100k free tokens and access to two model tiers. Click Activate to generate the first sample.
   - CTA: Activate trial (primary), Learn more (secondary)
3) In-product first-run experience (post-activation)
   - Guided sample prompt + expected outputs. Small footer: Contact partner support if you reach limits.

Copy variants (short/long for marketplace assets)
- Short headline (<= 50 chars): "Redwood + [PartnerApp]: Embeddable LLM in minutes"
- 220-char summary: "Integrate Redwood Inference with [PartnerApp] to add fast, cost-conscious LLM features. Onboard with a one-click sandbox: choose models, preview outputs, and control costs with built-in quotas."
- Long description (300–600 chars): use for listing details; include three bullets with what customers get (models, privacy/controls, enterprise SLA).

Acceptance criteria for listing go-live (ops + product)
- Sandbox activation tested end-to-end by partner engineer + Redwood solutions (smoke script pass).
- Listing text approved by partner marketing + Redwood legal (no restricted claims).
- Billing SKU confirmed and test invoice generated to validate event emission.
- Telemetry visible in Redwood Console: at least activation event + first-generation tokens.

Known risks / open questions
- Metering ambiguity: some partners expect per-call pricing while we meter tokens. Need canonical mapping and a README for partner PMs.
- Trial abuse: we need rate limits and heuristics; proposal: block identical repeated prompts >X in 60s during trial.
- Model fallback UX: if primary model is unavailable, do we surface a transparent message or silently swap? Recommend surface first with option to continue.

MVP playbook (concrete next steps for first partner)
Week 0 (prep)
  - Kickoff, sign NDA + addendum. Identify partner PM and eng lead.
  - Create sandbox org, initial SKUs stubbed.
Week 1 (integration)
  - Provide sandbox creds, run sample integration script, confirm token metering events.
  - Draft market listing short + long copy.
Week 2 (pilot & QA)
  - Internal smoke test, send invite cohort (~20 users), collect activation metrics.
  - Legal + marketing review, final copy.
Week 3 (launch)
  - Publish draft listing to marketplace (private/preview mode). Monitor telemetry and support queue.

Quick reference: sample smoke script (to share with partner eng)
- Step 1: curl auth token -> POST /v1/generate with sample prompt.json
- Step 2: assert 200 and tokens_used > 50
- Step 3: verify event emitted to billing stream (billing-event: trial_activation)
- Step 4: confirm Console shows activation under partner-id

Notes to self (Asha)
- Build small scripts to auto-generate SKU fallback tables from a partner-specified median prompt size.
- Consider adding a templated legal addendum with standard revenue share and trial clause to speed contracting.

Appendix: quick copy snippets for partner-facing channels
- Slack DM to partner PM: "Hi — I pushed a sandbox and draft listing copy to your drive. Want to run the smoke script together tomorrow?"
- Partner FAQ short: "How is usage billed? -> By token units; we provide a mapping table for typical API calls."

Open TODOs
- [ ] Finalize short listing headline variant A/B test (Lena)
- [ ] Add telemetry dashboard template to Console (Infra + Observability)
- [ ] Legal to review trial wording (Samir)
- [ ] Finance to confirm test invoice flow and SKU metadata semantics

References
- Existing marketplace listing templates (linked in artifacts).
- Customer-facing trial playbooks — see CONFLUENCE-8472.

-- end --
